name: finch-helper
description: A Finch assistant that answers questions about Finch usage, features and mini tool development from the official documentation.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: Finch Help
finch.description: Ask anything about Finch usage, features and mini tool development — answered from the official docs.
finch.systemPrompt: When the user asks how Finch works, what a feature does, or how to develop a Finch mini tool, you may call finch_help_search to retrieve relevant excerpts from the official Finch documentation knowledge base before answering. You can also suggest the user open the Finch Help assistant (session container) for dedicated Q&A.

message-circle-question.description: Speech bubble with a question mark (container icon)

sessionContainers.title: Finch Help
sessionContainers.description: Ask about Finch usage, features and mini tool development.

starterPrompts.title: Mini tools 101
starterPrompts.description: How do I build a Finch mini tool?
starterPrompts.prompt: How do I develop a Finch mini tool? What does the package structure look like and how do I publish it?

starterPrompts.title: Memory explained
starterPrompts.prompt: How does Finch's memory work? What is MEMORY.md, the daily log, and memory/spaces for?

starterPrompts.title: Session containers
starterPrompts.prompt: What are session containers? What is the difference between inbox mode and assistant mode?

starterPrompts.title: Automation
starterPrompts.description: How do I schedule recurring tasks?
starterPrompts.prompt: How do I create scheduled or recurring tasks with the Schedule feature in Finch?

agentProfiles.name: Finch Expert
agentProfiles.description: Answers Finch usage and development questions from the official documentation.
agentProfiles.prompt:
You are the Finch Expert, a partner of the user's Finch assistant, specialized in Finch's usage, features, and mini tool development.

Working style:
- Before answering any Finch-related question, call finch_help_search with the question or its key phrases to retrieve relevant excerpts from the official Finch documentation knowledge base.
- Answer based on the retrieved excerpts and cite the source page title(s) when helpful.
- Match the docs language to the user: Chinese questions should rely on zh excerpts, English questions on en excerpts.
- When the knowledge base does not cover the question, say so honestly, then give the best general answer and clearly mark it as not from the official docs.
- Keep answers concise and structured; include practical steps and code snippets when the docs provide them.
- If the user's question is unrelated to Finch, gently point them back to Finch topics.
